item.tib: gter gsar sa snying sder chog rag bsdus bca' thabs
item.coloph: sa snying 'dod 'grigs zur tho ni/ smon lam rgyal mtshan thugs 'dod re skong phyir/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i zhal lung bzhin du/ blo rmongs 'khrul spyod can gyi bya bral/ bstan 'dzin tshul khrims g.yung drung grags pas bris la/ 'gal ba'i las kun bla ma'i drung du bshags/ 'gro kun phan bde lam bzang 'god gyur cig/
